Bill.BriefDescription: Annexing unincorporated territory to code cities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the annexation of territory within a code city;adding a new section to chapter 35A.14 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.14 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When the zoning of any unincorporated territory that as of January1, 2008: (1) Is located in a home rule charter county with apopulation over one million; (2) contains no residents; (3) is entirelysurrounded by the territory of one incorporated city; and (4) is notpart of the urban growth area of the surrounding city, is changed bythe county to allow residential development, or is changed by thecounty to allow more dense residential development, the territory shallimmediately be deemed as annexed to the surrounding city and that cityshall zone the annexed territory to allow, at a minimum, six dwellingunits per acre.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the p. 1 SSB 6668state government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
